name: Punjabi Tandoor
menu_notes: Source: web search of DoorDash/Uber Eats/MenuPages current listings for the Mira Mesa (Activity Rd) location. Every checked dish still exists by name, but every price is drastically outdated: Combo#2 $7.99 stored vs ~$19.99-$24.99 current combo pricing, Chicken Tandoori $9.95 stored vs $15.99 current, Malai Kofta $4.95 stored vs $13.99 current, Matar Paneer $4.95 stored vs $14.99 current, Lamb Vindalu $5.95 stored vs $14.49 current -- this reads like a menu captured many years ago (roughly 2010s-era pricing) rather than a current one.
data_notes: Address (9235 Activity Rd #111, Mira Mesa) matches the Mira Mesa/Miramar location exactly (distinct from Punjabi Tandoor's other San Diego-area locations on Morehouse Dr, Sorrento Valley, etc.). Restaurant is open and well-reviewed. Cuisine label correct.
issues: Menu prices are roughly a decade stale -- most curries listed at $4.95-$5.95 and Nan at $1.95 when current prices for the same dishes run $13.99-$16.99, more than double to triple the stored values across nearly every dish
